bagPolicy.summary: Lumen Field enforces a clear bag policy to enhance public safety. Only clear bags, small clutches, and clear backpacks within specified dimensions are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12"
Clear backpacks with no more than 2 pockets
prohibited: Bags with pockets, zippered compartments, metal frames, or extra straps
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items, including diaper bags, are allowed after inspection at specific VIP and Club entrances.

parking.note: Lumen Field offers on-site parking at the Lumen Field Parking Garage and North Lot, both open daily. Parking rates may vary on event days, and pre-purchase is recommended due to limited availability. Oversized vehicles are only accommodated in the North Lot.

rideshare.note: For drop-off, use King Street at Occidental Avenue on the north side or Royal Brougham Way at Occidental Avenue on the south side.

concessions.note: Lumen Field offers a diverse range of food and drink options inspired by Northwest flavors. Highlights include specialty pizzas, burgers, poke nachos, and a variety of beverages including local craft beers and cocktails. Some stands feature Amazon's Just Walk Out Technology for a seamless experience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Additional ADA parking is available at the Union Station Garage on a first come, first served basis.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For Seahawks games, re-entry is only permitted up until kickoff, and once you exit after kickoff you cannot re-enter. Lumen Field First Aid can issue a medical pass in an emergency. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Lumen Field. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Guests who need accessibility accommodations can use the Accessible Entrance on Level 2 of the Lumen Field parking garage. The Green Elevator on the north side of the garage goes to the Club Level (Level 5), Suite Level (Level 6), and the accessible entrance.
